$comment: Shiny availability exceptions for DexPlanner. Lists species (PokeAPI species slugs) and forms (PokeAPI pokemon-form names) whose shiny cannot be obtained legitimately today: 'event' = a legitimate shiny existed only via past events/distributions, 'locked' = no legitimate shiny ever. Any species not listed is 'available' from a current game, Pokemon GO or a claimable Pokemon HOME gift. Checked 2026-10-18.

mew.note: Shiny only from past events (Japanese Emerald Old Sea Map, Pokemon GO Tour: Kanto 2021 Masterwork Research); gift Mew in Let's Go and Scarlet/Violet is shiny-locked

celebi.note: Shiny only from past distributions (2020-2021 events, past GO research) and the delisted Virtual Console Crystal
